The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Sergeant Tarl”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Sergeant Tarl (V)]] (published 18 June 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Sergeant Tarl]]).
